SELF-TEST MODE
The Self-Test mode {ts a special mode for checking the game switches and computer functions. It is the most complete way of checking for proper game operation and Is quite easy to use.

The Self-Test mode may be entered at any time and from any mode of oepration. Simply locate the black slide switch Inside the Coln Box compartment and slide it to the Se\f-Test posi- ‘tion, with this switch In the Self-Test position, activate the slam switch located on the Coln Door, The game will enter the Self-Test mode Immediately and display the following test menu..es

2. SOUNDS
3. PLAYER INPUT _ 4. GRID DISPLAY . -

SELF DIAGNOSTICS: This test Is designed to effectively focate and identify any malfunction of the on-board computer, When selected, the game enters this mode immediately and begins scanning the memory stored in rom and ram. If a defective component is found during the scan, that component and It's focation will be displayed on screen. It will take about 15 seconds to perform the entire test.

SOUNDS: When selected, this test will display a menu of sounds. The first two selections on the menu are ALL and EXIT. ‘f you move the cursor to select ALL, the game will automatically perform a test of all the sounds on the menue. If you move the cursor to select EXIT, the game wll\ exit the sound test and return to the main menu page. While in the sound test, any selection on the sound menu may be tested Individually by positioning the cursor next to that sound and pressing the SELECT button.

PLAYER INPUT: This test is designed to confirm the operation of all player Inputs and devices In the game. For example, when you wish to test the coin switches on the Cotn Door, you would enter this test and activate the coin switches. If the switches are operating properly, the screen will display the words COIN CHUTE 1, COIN CHUTE 2, COIN CHUTE 3, or COIN CHUTE 4 depending on which coln switch has been activated. All Inputs, pin controls, service switches, etc. may be tested in the same manner, To exit this test, activate the coin door slam switch.

GRID DISPLAY: This test was designed to display a crosshatch pattern used in adjusting the color monitor, This pattern may be used to adjust convergence, color balance, vertical linearity, and vertical/horizontal size. To exit this test, activate the coin door slam switch,
